official_gazette.name: Bundesgesetzblatt (recht.bund.de)
official_gazette.note: Electronic-only official federal gazette since 01.01.2023; free searchable archive with HTML, PDF, and ZIP downloads.

environmental_assessment_portal.name: UVP-Portal des Bundes
environmental_assessment_portal.note: Federal environmental impact assessment (EIA/SUP) portal linking to separate Länder UVP portals.

open_data_portal.name: GovData - Datenportal für Deutschland
open_data_portal.note: National CKAN metadata catalog harvesting federal, state, and municipal open datasets (including HVD metadata).

geoportal.name: Geoportal.de (GDI-DE)
geoportal.note: National spatial data portal of GDI-DE federating federal and state OGC services.

latest_orthophoto.name: BKG Digitale Orthophotos Bodenauflösung 20 cm (DOP20)
latest_orthophoto.note: BKG DOP20 Product Stand 2025-12 (delivery table 12.11.2026) is V GeoBund / paid ZSGT (>=2,500 EUR); many states also offer free Open-Data DOP20.
latest_orthophoto.service_type: WMS / WMTS (restricted V GeoBund or paid ZSGT)

cadastre.name: 16 Länder ALKIS Cadastres + ZSHH FS-DE / FS-BY
cadastre.note: Decentralized across 16 states (15 free Open Data, Bavaria paid); centralized only via paid ZSHH FS-DE+FS-BY or restricted BKG FS-DE.
